fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) rose 4% in afternoon trading to $393.59 after Finland approved the Full Self-Driving (FSD) system, with EU-level approval expected in winter
fields.summary_ko.1: Tesla's active FSD subscriptions increased 67% to 1.74 million in Q3 2026 from 1.04 million prior year, with European expansion underway
fields.summary_ko.2: Lucid Group (NASDAQ:LCID) fell 2% to $3.70 after Citi analyst lowered target price to $9 (from $11), with Q3 deliveries declining 7% year-over-year to 3,806 units
